positive_control.description: same map seed without queue exhaustion

steps: Verify binary SHA-256 before attaching the debugger.
Break when the search queue becomes empty and record queue state.
Observe target marker and bit 0x40000000 before backtracking.
At backtrack start capture ESI, cost, coordinates and prev_xyz.
At dangerous access confirm effective address and whether the write executes.
Repeat with the positive control and require safe completion.
completion_rule: No causal claim is runtime-observed until every point and the positive control are recorded.
